name: ConvertyBot – AI Sales Assistant for WooCommerce
author: 2wstechnologies

sections.description:
Stop losing sales to confused or undecided visitors! ConvertyBot is your intelligent AI sales assistant that engages customers, recommends products, and drives conversions around the clock.

Imagine having a knowledgeable salesperson available 24/7 who:
✅ Greets every visitor with a personalized message
✅ Recommends the perfect products based on their needs
✅ Answers questions instantly about your products
✅ Offers exclusive discount codes to close the sale
✅ Never takes a break, never gets tired!

Turn browsers into buyers with intelligent conversations.

Why ConvertyBot Changes Everything

🚀 Increase Conversions by 25%+ – Engage visitors at the right moment
💰 Boost Average Order Value – Smart product recommendations and upsells
⏰ 24/7 Sales Support – Never miss a sale, even while you sleep
🎯 Reduce Cart Abandonment – Offer incentives when customers hesitate
📊 Understand Your Customers – Deep insights into visitor behavior

Perfect For

  • E-commerce store owners who want to increase sales
  • Businesses looking to provide instant customer support
  • Marketers wanting to improve conversion rates
  • Store owners who can’t afford 24/7 human support
  • Anyone tired of losing sales to undecided visitors

Key Features

🤖 AI-Powered Conversations
* Natural, human-like conversations powered by advanced AI
* Understands customer intent and responds intelligently
* Learns your product catalog for accurate recommendations
* Multilingual support – speaks your customers’ language

🎁 Dynamic Coupon Generation
* Automatically generate personalized discount codes
* Set rules based on cart value, products, or customer behavior
* Create urgency with time-limited offers
* Track coupon performance in real-time

📦 Smart Product Recommendations
* AI analyzes customer preferences and browsing behavior
* Suggests relevant products that match customer needs
* Increases average order value with smart upsells
* Showcases your best products at the perfect moment

📈 Powerful Analytics Dashboard
* Track conversations, conversions, and revenue
* Monitor visitor journeys from first click to purchase
* Measure chatbot ROI with detailed reports
* Identify top-performing products and campaigns

🎨 Fully Customizable
* Match your brand with custom colors and styling
* Create your own chatbot persona and welcome messages
* Choose where and when the chatbot appears
* Mobile-responsive design works on all devices

🔒 Privacy & Security
* GDPR compliant with built-in consent management
* No personal data collected without permission
* Secure API communications
* WordPress security best practices

Real Results from Real Stores

“ConvertyBot increased our conversion rate by 32% in the first month. It’s like having a sales team that never sleeps!” – Fashion Store Owner

“The AI recommendations are incredibly accurate. Customers love getting personalized suggestions!” – Electronics Retailer

“We saw a 40% reduction in cart abandonment after implementing the coupon feature.” – Home & Garden Shop

What Your Chatbot Can Do

Welcome & Engage:
* “Hi! Looking for something special today? I’m here to help!”
* “Welcome back! I noticed you were interested in [product]. Still looking?”

Recommend Products:
* “Based on what you’re looking for, I’d recommend these…”
* “Customers who bought this also loved…”

Answer Questions:
* “This product comes in 3 sizes: S, M, and L”
* “Yes, we offer free shipping on orders over $50!”

Close the Sale:
* “Here’s an exclusive 10% discount just for you: SAVE10”
* “This item is selling fast – only 3 left in stock!”

Installation is Simple

  1. Install in 1 click from your WordPress admin
  2. Run the setup wizard to configure your AI assistant
  3. Customize the appearance to match your brand
  4. Start converting visitors into customers!

No coding required. No technical skills needed. Just install and start selling!

Pricing Plans

🆓 Free Trial (14 Days)
* 100 conversations/month
* Basic AI responses
* Standard product recommendations
* AI-generated smart coupons
* Email support
* Perfect for testing the waters

⭐ Starter Plan ($49/month or $490/year)
* 1,000 conversations/month
* Advanced AI responses

* Priority email support
* Basic analytics
* Save 2 months with yearly billing!

💼 Professional Plan ($149/month or $1,490/year)
* 10,000 conversations/month
* Premium AI with GPT-4
* AI-powered personalization
* Rule-based coupon automation

* Save 2 months with yearly billing!

🚀 Enterprise Plan (Custom Pricing)
* Unlimited conversations
* Custom AI training
* Advanced coupon analytics
* Dedicated account manager
* 24/7 priority support
* White-label solution

14-Day Free Trial

Start with a free 14-day trial including 100 conversations. No credit card required!

ConvertyBot website: https://convertybot.com/

External Services

  • Product catalog data is securely transmitted for AI processing

No personal data is collected without user consent. The plugin includes a GDPR-compliant consent banner.

Privacy Policy: https://convertybot.com/privacy

Support & Community

  • Documentation: https://convertybot.com/docs
  • Support Email: support@convertybot.com

Why Choose ConvertyBot?

💰 Increase Revenue – Convert more visitors into paying customers
⏰ Save Time – Let AI handle customer questions 24/7
📈 Grow Faster – Scale your sales without scaling your team
🎯 Better Targeting – Personalized recommendations that convert
🛡️ Stay Secure – GDPR compliant with enterprise security
🚀 Start Free – No risk, immediate results
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “ConvertyBot”
  4. Click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Follow the setup wizard to configure your AI assistant!

Manual Installation

  1. Download the convertybot.zip file
  2. Upload to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Extract the files
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  5. Go to ‘AI Chatbot’ in your admin menu to start setup

After Installation

  1. Complete the setup wizard (takes less than 5 minutes)
  2. Customize your chatbot’s appearance and messages
  3. Set up coupon rules for automatic discounts
  4. Watch your conversions grow!
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, ConvertyBot is designed specifically for WooCommerce stores. You need WooCommerce installed and active.

Is there a free version?

Absolutely! The free plan includes 50 conversations per month, forever free. Perfect for testing or small stores.

Do I need technical skills to set it up?

Not at all! Our setup wizard guides you through everything. If you can click a button, you can set up ConvertyBot.

Can I customize how the chatbot looks?

Yes! You can customize colors, welcome messages, chatbot name, avatar, position, and more to match your brand perfectly.

Will it slow down my website?

No. ConvertyBot is optimized for performance with lazy loading and minimal footprint. It won’t affect your page speed.

Is customer data secure?

Yes! We follow WordPress security best practices and are fully GDPR compliant. No personal data is collected without explicit consent.

Does it work with my theme?

ConvertyBot is compatible with all WordPress themes and page builders including Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, and more.

Can I use it in multiple languages?

Yes! ConvertyBot supports multiple languages and can communicate with customers in their preferred language.

How accurate are the product recommendations?

Very accurate! Our AI analyzes your product catalog and customer behavior to make intelligent, relevant recommendations.

What if I need help?

Free users get email support. Paid plans include priority support, and Enterprise users get a dedicated account manager.

Can I try it before paying?

Yes! Start with our free plan, or try any paid plan free for 14 days with no credit card required.

How do I track performance?

The built-in analytics dashboard shows conversations, conversions, revenue, visitor journeys, and more in real-time.
